messages:
Maya (CSM): Morning team — quick weekly check-in for Kyrius onboarding. They reported UX regressions and we saw an uptick in errors this week. Can someone post a short breakdown by 5xx, timeouts, and rate-limits plus the top failing endpoints? Need this for renewal/health notes before Friday.

Ben (SRE): On it. Quick snapshot from the last 7 days for account=kyrius: overall error rate 1.9% (was 0.4% last week). Breakdown: 5xx ~0.9%, timeouts ~0.7%, rate-limits ~0.3%.

Ishan (Eng): Sharing the query I ran: ```SELECT endpoint, error_type, count(*) as failures FROM logs WHERE account = 'kyrius' AND ts >= '2026-03-14' GROUP BY endpoint, error_type ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 20;``` Results (top rows): `/v1/generate  5xx 410`, `/v1/embed  timeout 120`, `/v1/batch  429 90`, `/v1/generate/stream  5xx 45`, `/internal/kv  timeout 28`.

Ben (SRE): Adding a brief timeline: spike started 2026-03-16 05:00 UTC with a traffic surge from a Kyrius test harness. Between 05:00-06:30 we saw increased OOM-related 500s on a subset of hosts after a canary change to batching window. After that we saw more client retries which bumped timeouts. Rate-limits are from per-account concurrent request limits being hit during the retries.

Lina (AE): Confirmed with Kyrius — they started a load-capture job on 2026-03-16 to simulate peak loads. They didn't notify CS before ramp. They're open to mitigations.

Maya (CSM): Ok action items: (1) Eng (Ishan/Ben) — revert or tighten the canary batch-window and push a quick fix to reduce OOM 5xxs; (2) SRE — temporarily raise Kyrius per-account concurrency to prevent 429s while we stabilize; (3) CS (Maya/Lina) — notify Kyrius about mitigation plan and expected ETA. Please respond with short ack and ETA.

Ishan (Eng): ack. I'll revert the canary and roll a narrowed batch config in the next 40m. If that doesn't fully address it, I'll open a debug session with the runtime team.

Ben (SRE): ack. I'll bump the account concurrency limits and watch for 5xx reduction. Will confirm when rollout completes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback job started by Ishan at 2026-03-16T08:21:00Z.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed at 2026-03-16T08:42:12Z — 7 instances reverted. Monitoring metrics for next 30m.

Ben (SRE): Post-rollback quick metrics: 5xx rate down from 0.9% to 0.35% in the 30m window after rollback, timeouts down ~40%, 429s reduced by 75% after raising concurrency. Will follow up with a more detailed graph later today.

Maya (CSM): Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll update the Kyrius renewal health doc with these numbers and note mitigations. Please drop the detailed graph links here when available. :thumbsup:
